Announcing the First Ever AMA Nexus Event for the Champz Community!

The AMA has Evolved, Ask Me Anything is now the A.I. Magistrate Arena

You can still ask us anything but now we have a Virtual Third Space Nexus in which to host the AMA.

Join us in the AMA Nexus next Monday, July 6th at 6 PM UTC at the Nexus https://t.co/pAtpup8oVm or you can watch the livestream on Twitter https://t.co/H8gHhTwOuE

The Following Prizes:

1 Million Champz Tokens
1 Event Specific Unique Legend
4 Event Specific Legendary Legends
1 Event Specific Epic Legend
Unique Role inside the Newly Created Champz DAO

—-Important—-

To Qualify for the Prizes you will need to create an AI Agent, fund your account with a small amount, set the parameters, and have it compete in the event. This can all be done in the Base Mini-app and we will be able to help during the transmission. We will also take the first 20 minutes of the AMA event to help anyone configure their agent in the mini app.

Whilst watching the AI Agents battle for Financial Supremacy, Humans will compete in rapid fire quiz competitions for Legend Characters and have a chat discussion about the following:

-Review and Updates for the LoC Roadmap Phase 2 incoming

-Discussion about OG Champz Updates and Status

-Leak of partnership with Spirit DAO (https://t.co/yCVca1HasW) as Champz the Indie Gaming Studio continues to move towards a community owned, governed, and driven company.

-Spirit DAO is a mobile complete DAO system that will help with governance, time bound rewards, gated-roles, and community building/recognition via achievements and NFTs.

-We will discuss the establishment of a monthly AMA Nexus Game Night Event with the community using Spirit DAO to onboard and vote for the community initiatives.

-This AMA Nexus will be a warm up to try out the agents battling, chat features, quiz, and other mechanics beta test.

-Introduction of the new G.N.A.A.S. (Game Night As A Service) that we are offering white label to other communities and projects on Base.

Community roots us in everything we do. Look forward to seeing you there for this first of its kind event in the web 3 space, Cheers!

What a month it's been!

As our Forget Me Not Appeal 2026 comes to a close, we're looking back on some incredible moments made possible by our supporters, volunteers, partners and campaigners.

Across the month of June, we 👇

- Saw more than 117,000 people proudly wear our Forget Me Not Appeal badge in honour of loved ones affected by dementia

- Joined with 50,000 supporters and @jonsnowC4 to call for better dementia diagnosis through our open letter

- Announced 17 new research grants to help explore dementia's causes, diagnosis, treatment and prevention

- Celebrated the two-year extension of our partnership with The FA

- Raised an amazing £1.5 million to help fund life-changing support and ground-breaking research

- Celebrated our incredible volunteers during Volunteers' Week

- Helped deliver support through over 6,000 calls to our Dementia Support Line

Thank you for making this Forget Me Not Appeal so special and helping us get one step closer to ending the devastation caused by dementia 💙
